_comment: Stage 4a model settings, fixed BEFORE any result is read (notebook cells 3, 63). Changing a value means a new evaluated pipeline; never change them after looking at test results.

periods.test_status: reused holdout: June-July 2026 was examined while the method was developed (notebook); not an untouched final test

_n_jobs_note: The notebook uses n_jobs=2. With 2 threads sklearn adds the 100 tree predictions in thread-finishing order, so repeated predict() calls differed by up to 3.6e-12 boardings and a reloaded model could not reproduce stored predictions exactly. n_jobs=1 gives the same trees (per-tree seeds are fixed in advance) and exactly repeatable predictions. Decided at the freeze step, before any test scoring.
_max_model_file_note: 20 MB = 20,000,000 bytes, checked on the saved (compressed) file
missing_history_policy: Option 2: fill missing 28-day boardings from the 7/14/21-day mean, keep availability flag
